post.description: Starts connecting one integration to the workspace. For OAuth providers, returns a consent link that is personal to the signed-in person and workspace and expires after ten minutes, or status `connected` when an existing connection is recovered. A new connection completes after the person approves access in a browser signed in to the same Superlog account and workspace. For integrations that need credentials or extra setup, returns a link to secure setup in Superlog.

post.description: Creates a check that requests a URL on a schedule and checks the response. After `failuresToAlert` failed runs in a row it posts to its Slack channel, and posts the recovery in the same thread. Defaults: GET, every 300 seconds, a 10 second timeout, 1 retry, alert after 1 failure, follow redirects, enabled.

key.description: The header name for `header`, or the JSON path for `json_path`, such as `$.status`.

kind.description: What the assertion reads: the status code, response time in ms, a header, the body text, a JSON path, or days until the TLS certificate expires.

op.description: `status_code` takes eq, neq, lt, gt; `response_time` lt; `header` eq, neq, contains, not_contains, exists, not_exists; `body` contains, not_contains; `json_path` all; `certificate_expiry` gt.

severity.description: A failed `critical` assertion fails the run; a `degraded` one marks it degraded. Defaults to `critical`.

value.description: Compared with the response. A status code may be a class such as `2xx`.

assertions.description: Checks on the response. Without any, a run passes when the request completes.

body.description: The request body. Not for GET or HEAD.

enabled.description: A disabled check does not run.

failuresToAlert.description: Failed runs in a row before the check posts to Slack.

headers.description: Request headers. The list replaces the saved headers.

intervalSeconds.description: How often the check runs: one of 60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600 seconds.

retries.description: Immediate retries before a run counts as failed.

channelId.description: The Slack channel ID: the `channelId` of a channel alerts can post to.

integrationAccountId.description: The ID of the Slack integration the channel belongs to.

slack.description: Where failures and recoveries are posted. Without a channel the check only records its runs.
